experiences.cancellationPolicyDesc: Any experience can be canceled and fully refunded within 24 hours of purchase, or at least 7 days before the experience starts.
experiences.personRequirementsDesc: Up to 10 guests ages 4 and up can attend. Parents may also bring children under 2 years of age.
whatToBringList: Be ready before the scheduled pickup time
experiences.longDescription:
PRIVATE TUK-TUK TOUR - tailored around you.

Our guide will meet you at the agreed pickup point and begin the tour in a comfortable, 100% electric tuk-tuk. The route includes viewpoints, historic streets, and local stops adapted to your pace and interests.

Short breaks are included where indicated. At the end of the tour we return to the original pickup point or another agreed central location.

Times are indicative and can be adjusted on request.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: Lisbon Mates offers a convenient pick-up service directly from hotels and local accommodation (Airbnb) located in the center of Lisbon.

stops.title: Santa Luzia
stops.description: One of the most romantic viewpoints in the city, with a stunning view over the rooftops of Alfama and the Tagus River.

stops.title: Lisbon Cathedral (Sé)
stops.description: The oldest church in the city, imposing with its Romanesque architecture and centuries of history.

stops.title: Senhora do Monte Viewpoint
stops.description: The highest point in the city, offering one of the most spectacular and complete panoramic views of Lisbon.

stops.title: National Pantheon
stops.description: Originally the Church of Santa Engrácia, it is one of the most emblematic monuments in Lisbon, today serving as a resting place for important historical figures in Portugal.

stops.title: Alfama
stops.description: The oldest neighborhood in Lisbon and one of the most authentic. Famous for its narrow streets, colorful houses and traditional Fado culture.

stops.title: Church of Saint Anthony
stops.description: The picturesque church built in the exact place where Saint Anthony, Lisbon's most beloved patron saint, was born.

stops.title: Portas do Sol Viewpoint
stops.description: One of the most famous viewpoints in Lisbon, located in the heart of Alfama, with spectacular views over the Tagus River and historic rooftops.

stops.title: Graça
stops.description: A vibrant and historic neighborhood with an artistic atmosphere, famous for its terraces and iconic viewpoints.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: At the end of your experience, we can drop you off at your hotel, Airbnb in the center of Lisbon or at our meeting point at Avenida da Liberdade, nº 3.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: We pick you up directly at your hotel or accommodation in the central region of Lisbon. If you are staying outside the center, we can arrange a nearby meeting point.

stops.title: Carmo Convent
stops.description: Gothic ruins of a 14th century convent, partially destroyed by the 1755 earthquake. It has been roofless since then, creating a unique open-air atmosphere.

stops.title: Bertrand Bookstore
stops.description: Founded in 1732, it is officially recognized as the oldest bookstore in the world still in operation. It is in the heart of Chiado.

stops.title: Santa Justa Elevator
stops.description: Opened in 1902 to connect Baixa to Chiado. Iron structure inspired by French industrial architecture, with panoramic views from the top.

stops.title: Church of São Roque
stops.description: 16th-century Jesuit church, famous for its richly decorated baroque interior and chapels. One of the most important religious monuments in Lisbon.

stops.title: São Pedro de Alcântara Viewpoint
stops.description: One of the most popular viewpoints in the city, with views over Baixa and Castelo de São Jorge. It combines gardens, terraces and panoramic views.

stops.title: Bairro Alto
stops.description: One of Lisbon's most traditional and vibrant neighborhoods. During the day it preserves its historic charm, and at night it transforms into one of the liveliest spots in the city.

stops.title: Luís de Camões Square
stops.description: Important square that connects Chiado to Bairro Alto. It is named after the greatest Portuguese poet and is a traditional meeting point for artists and visitors.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: At the end of the tour, we return you to your hotel or accommodation in Lisbon, or to a previously agreed meeting point.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: We pick you up directly at your hotel or accommodation in the central region of Lisbon. If you are staying outside the center, we can arrange a nearby meeting point.

stops.title: Belém Tower
stops.description: Built in the 16th century on the banks of the Tagus, it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a symbol of the Age of Discoveries. Its Manueline architecture is one of Lisbon's most photographed postcards.

stops.title: Pastéis de Belém
stops.description: Stop at the bakery where the original recipe for pastel de nata has been preserved for generations. Crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside, it is an essential gastronomic tradition.

stops.title: Jerónimos Monastery
stops.description: Masterpiece of Manueline architecture, built to celebrate Vasco da Gama's trip to India. It houses the navigator's tomb inside.

stops.title: Monument to the Discoveries
stops.description: Monument in the shape of a caravel facing the Tagus, which pays homage to Portuguese navigators. It features the figure of Infante Dom Henrique among other historical personalities.

stops.title: Pink Street
stops.description: Former street linked to the port's nightlife, today one of the trendiest areas in Lisbon. Pink pavement and lively bars mark the city's modern social scene.

stops.title: 25 de Abril Bridge
stops.description: Often compared to the Golden Gate for its appearance, it connects Lisbon to the south bank of the Tagus. Its current name pays homage to the Revolution of April 25, 1974.

stops.title: Time Out Market
stops.description: Located in the historic Mercado da Ribeira, it brings together some of the best gastronomic experiences in Lisbon in one place, from traditional to contemporary.

stops.title: Belém Palace
stops.description: Official residence of the President of the Portuguese Republic. Historic building surrounded by gardens, symbol of the country's political power.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: At the end of the tour, we guarantee a comfortable return to your hotel or accommodation, or to a previously agreed point.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: Personalized pick-up service directly from your hotel or accommodation to start your full day in Lisbon.

stops.title: Belém and historical monuments
stops.description: Explore the Belém Tower, the Monument to the Discoveries and make a delicious stop at the famous and original Pastéis de Belém.

stops.title: Jerónimos Monastery
stops.description: Guided tour outside this magnificent masterpiece of Manueline architecture from the 16th century.

stops.title: Baixa Pombalina and Praça do Comércio
stops.description: Passage through the monumental area rebuilt after the 1755 earthquake, connecting the large squares to the Tagus River.

stops.title: Chiado and Traditional Lunch
stops.description: Break in the elegant and bohemian neighborhood of Chiado with free time to enjoy a traditional Portuguese lunch.

stops.title: Viewpoints and Historic Hills
stops.description: Take a Tuk-Tuk ride to the highest points of the city, including Senhora do Monte and São Pedro de Alcântara, for breathtaking views.

stops.title: Old Alfama
stops.description: Guided walk through the oldest medieval streets in Lisbon, delving into the soul and history of Fado.

stops.title: Lisbon Cathedral and Saint Anthony
stops.description: Visit to the Lisbon Cathedral and the historic church built on the birthplace of Saint Anthony.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: End your full-day tour with direct and comfortable return to your hotel or central point of choice.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: Pick up directly from your accommodation to begin a panoramic route through Lisbon's most famous hills.

stops.title: São Pedro de Alcântara Viewpoint
stops.description: A classic and monumental view over Baixa Pombalina, Graça hill and the imposing São Jorge Castle.

stops.title: Santa Catarina Viewpoint (Adamastor)
stops.description: Relaxed atmosphere on the edge of the hill with a wide view over the port of Lisbon, the bridge and Cristo Rei.

stops.title: Senhora do Monte Viewpoint
stops.description: The absolute top of Lisbon. The most spectacular panoramic view, where we can see almost the entire length of the ancient city.

stops.title: Graça Viewpoint
stops.description: Located next to the iconic church, it is one of Lisbon residents' favorite stopping points to observe the old city under the shade of the pine trees.

stops.title: Portas do Sol Viewpoint
stops.description: An authentic medieval balcony suspended over the traditional roofs of Alfama and the perfect curvature of the Tagus River.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: Disembark comfortably at your hotel or at a viewpoint of your choice to enjoy the evening.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: We pick you up in the late afternoon at your hotel with the Tuk-Tuk fully decorated and prepared for the magic of Christmas.

stops.title: Praça do Comércio and Giant Christmas Tree
stops.description: Enjoy the grand lighting of Lisbon's largest square and its traditional, giant, shiny Christmas tree.

stops.title: Rua Augusta and Illuminated Baixa
stops.description: Stroll beneath the ceilings of twinkling lights and themed decorations of the city's busiest shopping streets.

stops.title: Rossio and Christmas Market
stops.description: Passage through Rossio and optional stop to explore the small wooden huts with handicrafts, typical sweets and mulled wine.

stops.title: Avenida da Liberdade
stops.description: Parade along Lisbon's most luxurious avenue, completely decorated with thousands of LED lights on its centuries-old trees.

stops.title: Chiado and Praça Luís de Camões
stops.description: Immerse yourself in the magical and artistic atmosphere of Chiado with its famous bright facades that enchant children and adults alike.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: Comfortable return to your hotel or restaurant of your choice to enjoy Christmas dinner.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: Private pickup in the morning at your hotel to begin an unforgettable journey towards the stunning Serra de Sintra.

stops.title: Pena National Palace
stops.description: Explore the most colorful and romantic palace in Europe, built on top of the mountain like a true fairytale castle.

stops.title: Sintra Historic Village
stops.description: Free time to explore the medieval lanes, visit local shops, and taste Sintra's famous queijadas and travesseiros pastries.

stops.title: Cabo da Roca
stops.description: Visit to the westernmost point of continental Europe, where the sea meets the impressive rocky cliffs.

stops.title: Boca do Inferno
stops.description: Admire the dramatic force of the Atlantic Ocean sculpting the caves and rock formations on the coast of Cascais.

stops.title: Cascais and Estoril Coast
stops.description: Tour through the charming coastal village of Cascais, former summer residence of royalty, returning along the scenic coastal road.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: Return in complete comfort and safety directly to your accommodation in Lisbon.

stops.title: Choose your pickup point
stops.description: Private departure from your hotel in Lisbon towards the historical, religious and cultural heart of central Portugal.

stops.title: Sanctuary of Fátima
stops.description: Visit to the site of the Marian apparitions of 1917, visiting the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary, the Chapel of Apparitions and the Basilica of the Holy Trinity.

stops.title: Batalha Monastery
stops.description: An imposing jewel of Portuguese Gothic and Manueline architecture, classified as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

stops.title: Nazaré and the Giant Waves Viewpoint
stops.description: Climb to Sítio da Nazaré for a breathtaking panoramic view of the beach and the iconic giant waves of Canhão da Nazaré.

stops.title: Óbidos Medieval Village
stops.description: Travel back in time as you walk along the walls and streets of Óbidos, ending with the classic Ginjinha served in a chocolate cup.

stops.title: Choose your drop-off point
stops.description: Comfortable and relaxing return with final drop-off at your hotel or accommodation point in Lisbon.
